home_lede: Rampsmith finds WCAG 2.2 AA failures in your Shopify store and fixes them in your own data and theme code, with a dated record of every change.
home_note: Automated checks find many accessibility issues, not all of them. Rampsmith tells you what it checked and what still needs a person.
embedded_failed: Rampsmith could not reach your store. Reload the app to try again.
embedded_next_body: Scans, findings and fixes arrive in the next release. Your store's access is set up and kept current.
error_body: Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, contact support and quote reference {reference}.
dash_empty: Your sites and agency stores will appear here.
dash_agency_caption: Stores that approved a link to your organizations
dash_agency_code_body: Give this code to the store owner. In Rampsmith, inside their Shopify admin, they open Agency access, enter it and approve. It works once and expires on {expires}. It cannot be shown again.
dash_agency_error: That did not work. Try again in a moment.
dash_agency_error_limit: This organization already has the most unused codes. Wait for one to expire.
dash_agency_lede: Follow several Shopify stores from one place. A store appears here only after its owner approves the link inside Rampsmith, and it disappears as soon as either side ends the link.
dash_agency_orgs_empty: You have no organization yet. Create one to link stores.
dash_agency_stores_empty: No store has approved a link yet.
signin_lede: Use the passkey saved on this device or in your password manager.
signin_failed: Sign-in did not complete. Try again, or create an account if you do not have one.
register_lede: Your account is protected by a passkey instead of a password.
register_failed: The account could not be created. {reason}
passkeys_unsupported: This browser cannot use passkeys. Use an up-to-date browser to continue.
passkeys_need_js: Passkeys need JavaScript. Turn it on to sign in.
app_agency_about: Once you approve it here, an agency or company can follow this store from its own Rampsmith dashboard. It sees the checks passed, how many issues are open, new regressions and the date of the last scan. It cannot change anything, and it cannot see your customers or your storefront password. You can revoke access at any time.
app_agency_add_body: Ask the agency for a link code from its Rampsmith dashboard. A code works once and expires after a day.
app_agency_approved: {name} can now see this store's summary.
app_agency_caption: Agencies that can see this store
app_agency_code_invalid: This code is not valid, or it has expired.
app_agency_code_limited: Too many codes were not valid. Try again in an hour.
app_agency_confirm_body: Approve only if you expect this request. It gives {name} a read-only summary of this store.
app_agency_empty: No agency can see this store.
app_agency_failed: That did not work. Try again in a moment.
app_agency_revoke_failed: Access could not be revoked. Try again.
app_announce_approved: Approved the alt text for {product}. It is being applied to your store.
app_announce_edited: Saved your edit to the alt text for {product}.
app_announce_undone: Undid the alt text change for {product}. The earlier text is back.
app_applied_empty: Nothing has been applied yet. Approved alt text appears here, where you can undo it.
app_checks_caveat: Automated checks find many accessibility issues, not all of them. What they cannot decide needs a person.
app_criterion_learn: Understanding success criterion {id} (opens in a new tab)
app_edit_empty: Write some alt text, or reject this suggestion.
app_edit_too_long: Alt text can be at most {max} characters.
app_error_conflict: This changed while you were working. Reload and try again.
app_error_forbidden: Your plan or role does not allow this.
app_error_network: Rampsmith could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
app_error_rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
app_error_unauthenticated: Your session expired. Reload the app to sign in again.
app_error_unavailable: Rampsmith is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.
app_error_validation: Some of the values are not valid. Check them and try again.
app_evidence_after_alt: Screenshot of the element after the fix
app_evidence_before_alt: Screenshot of the element before the fix
app_feature_prs_body: Rampsmith can open a pull request with a theme code fix for you to review and merge.
app_feature_rewrites_body: Rampsmith can suggest clearer product descriptions for your review.
app_finding_no_evidence: No before and after evidence has been captured yet.
app_finding_no_fix: There is no fix for this issue yet.
app_finding_no_occurrences: No occurrences are recorded for this issue.
app_findings_empty_body: Run a scan to check your store, or come back after the next scheduled scan.
app_findings_table_caption: Open accessibility issues, most important first
app_fix_failed: This change could not be applied. Nothing on your store was changed.
app_fix_flag_confirm: I checked this alt text against the image and it describes it correctly
app_fix_flag_heading: Check this draft before you approve it
app_fix_flag_instruction_like_text_seen: The AI reported text in the image or in your store data that looked like instructions to it.
app_fix_flag_suspected_prompt_injection: The product title or type reads like an instruction to an AI, so the draft may not describe the image.
app_fix_has_text: The image contains text. Check that the alt text repeats it.
app_log_caption: Every change Rampsmith made or proposed, with who approved it and how it was verified
app_log_empty_body: Changes appear here once Rampsmith proposes them.
app_log_export_body: Download the log as a spreadsheet or as data, to keep with your accessibility records.
app_log_export_failed: The log could not be downloaded.
app_overview_empty_body: Run your first scan to see which accessibility issues your store has.
app_plan_drafts: AI alt text drafts this period: {used} of {limit}
app_queue_empty: Nothing is waiting for review. New alt text suggestions appear here after a scan.
app_regression_about: Rampsmith compares each scheduled scan with the scan before it. A regression is an issue that is new, or one that was gone and came back. Issues you accepted as a risk or marked as false positives are left out.
app_regression_banner_body: New issues: {added}. Issues that came back: {returned}.
app_regression_banner_heading: New issues found by the latest scheduled scan
app_regression_caption: Issues found by the scheduled scan of {when} that the scan before it did not have
app_regression_counts: New issues: {added}. Issues that came back: {returned}.
app_regression_dismiss_failed: The banner could not be dismissed.
app_regression_dismissed: Dismissed. The record stays on this page.
app_regression_empty_body: Every scheduled scan is compared with the one before it. Regressions appear here, and Rampsmith emails you when one is found.
app_regression_locked_body: On this plan Rampsmith scans on the schedule your plan includes, but does not compare scans or alert you when new issues appear.
app_regression_locked_heading: Regression alerts are part of a higher plan
app_regression_more: And {count} more. Open the issues list to see them all.
app_scan_failed_body: The last scan did not finish. Nothing on your store was changed. Try again.
app_scan_partial_body: Some pages could not be checked, so these results are incomplete.
app_scan_start_failed: The scan could not be started.
app_scan_started: Scan started. Results appear here as pages are checked.
app_settings_budget_hint: Rampsmith stops drafting when the budget is used. Your plan allows up to {max}.
app_settings_chars_hint: Short alt text is easier to listen to. 150 is a good limit.
app_settings_email_hint: Rampsmith writes here about scan results and fixes waiting for you.
app_settings_password_hint: Only if your store is password protected. Rampsmith stores it encrypted and uses it only to scan.
app_settings_password_saved: A password is saved. Enter a new one to replace it.
app_settings_weekly_hint: Rampsmith checks your store once a week and tells you if something new breaks.
app_settings_weekly_locked: Weekly rescans are part of paid plans.
app_statement_compatibility: Browsers and assistive technology you have tested with
app_statement_contact_hint: Tell visitors how to report a barrier. Give at least one way to reach you.
app_statement_copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
app_statement_intro: Write the statement for your store. Rampsmith adds what it found in its scans and what it did not check, so the statement stays accurate.
app_statement_limitations_hint: Add barriers you know about that the scans cannot find. Leave this empty if there are none.
app_statement_measures_hint: One measure per line, such as "We test new pages with a screen reader".
app_statement_no_versions: No version has been saved yet.
app_statement_review_note: This statement is a draft for you to review. Have it checked by someone qualified before you publish it. Attorney review required.
app_statement_save_failed: The statement could not be saved.
app_statement_status_no_known_barriers: The latest automated checks found no barriers. This does not mean the whole site meets the standard.
app_statement_status_not_evaluated: Not evaluated yet. Run a scan first.
app_statement_preview_incomplete: The preview appears once the contact details and the other entries are filled in correctly. Add at least one way to contact you.
site_footer_note: Automated checks find only part of all accessibility issues. Rampsmith tells you what it checked and what still needs a person.
site_footer_draft: The privacy policy, terms and addendum are drafts that await attorney review.
site_home_eyebrow: For Shopify stores and the agencies that run them
site_home_find_body: It checks eight page types and four interactive states against WCAG 2.2 A and AA, then ranks what it finds by how much it gets in a shopper's way.
site_home_fix_body: Store data, such as image descriptions, is corrected where it lives. Theme code arrives as exact patches your developer can review as GitHub pull requests.
site_home_record_body: Every fix carries the finding, the WCAG criterion, before and after evidence, who approved it and when. Data fixes undo with one click.
site_home_never_overlay_title: No overlay and no toolbar widget
site_home_never_overlay_body: Nothing is added on top of your storefront. Rampsmith changes the data and the code a barrier comes from.
site_home_never_claims_body: Rampsmith reports what it checked, for example "Passes 41 of 47 automated WCAG 2.2 AA checks". It gives no legal advice and does not say that a store meets any law.
site_home_limits_title: Automated checks are only part of the picture
site_home_limits_body: axe-core, the engine behind most accessibility testing, finds on average 57% of WCAG issues automatically and returns uncertain results as incomplete. Rampsmith lists what automation cannot see and queues uncertain results for a person to review.
site_home_who_owner_body: Exposure ranked in plain language, fixes without touching code, and proof of effort.
site_home_who_agency_body: Exact patches, pull requests, client-ready reports and one dashboard for every store you run.
site_home_who_team_body: Continuous monitoring, regression alerts and an audit trail for a brand with a developer on staff.
site_home_end_body: Check a public site's home page and two linked pages. No account, and nothing is published.
site_how_lede: From the first scan to a dated record of what changed, in four steps.
site_how_s1_body: Rampsmith loads your store's pages in a real browser, with the menu opened by keyboard, the cart drawer open, a variant picked and the first popup found. It also audits store data without a browser.
site_how_s2_body: Findings are ranked by impact on shoppers and by how often that failure appears in complaints. Each one names its WCAG 2.2 success criterion and shows the element.
site_how_s3_body: You approve every change. Rampsmith proposes it, shows exactly what will change, and applies it only after you say yes.
site_how_s4_body: A follow-up scan proves the finding is gone and nothing new appeared. Scans repeat on a schedule, and a failure that returns is surfaced.
site_how_channels_lede: Rampsmith never writes your theme files through Shopify's API. Each kind of fix takes the route that keeps you in control.
site_how_ch_data_what: Image descriptions, titles and other content Shopify holds as data, changed through the Admin API.
site_how_ch_pr_what: Exact code patches for a theme kept in GitHub. Your team reviews and merges them.
site_how_ch_pkg_what: A copy of your theme with the patches applied, checked by a preview re-scan, for you to upload yourself.
site_how_ch_pkg_undo: Switch back to the original theme.
site_how_people_body: Some barriers need human judgement: whether alt text says what matters, whether a flow makes sense with a screen reader, how third-party app code behaves. Rampsmith lists these in its report and, for third-party apps, drafts a notice you can send to the vendor.
site_how_checks_pages: Page types: home, collection, product, cart, search results, customer account login, standard page and blog article.
site_how_checks_states: Interactive states: main navigation opened by keyboard, the cart drawer after add to cart, a changed variant picker and the first modal or popup found.
site_how_checks_out: Shopify-controlled checkout pages are outside what any app can change, so Rampsmith leaves them out.
site_pricing_lede: Four plans, billed through Shopify App Pricing in US dollars. Yearly prices include two months free.
site_plan_pro_scans: Daily; every template variant, 25 samples each
site_plan_free_fixes: Data fixes for the first 25 images
site_plan_starter_fixes: Data fixes; the 6 core recipes as GitHub pull requests
site_plan_growth_fixes: Adds every recipe, description rewrites and regression alerts
site_plan_pro_fixes: Adds AI proposals for custom widgets, multi-language statements and a priority queue
site_pricing_matrix_lede: Features your plan does not include stay visible and are marked with the plan that unlocks them.
site_feature_core_prs: The 6 core recipes as GitHub pull requests
site_feature_all_recipes: Every recipe as a pull request
site_pricing_note_billing: Shopify merchants pay through Shopify App Pricing, so charges appear on your Shopify invoice.
site_pricing_note_agency: The agency dashboard is free. Commercial terms for agencies are still being decided.
site_pricing_note_free: The Free plan is not a trial. Its 25 alt-text drafts are a one-time allowance.
site_pricing_note_limits: Automated checks find only part of all accessibility issues on every plan.
site_scan_lede: Enter the address of a public website. Rampsmith checks its home page and two linked pages against WCAG 2.2 A and AA at one screen size, then shows how many checks failed, with three examples of each kind.
site_scan_know_partial: The check is automated and partial. Automated testing finds on average 57% of WCAG issues, so a clean result does not mean a site has no barriers.
site_scan_know_limits: Each visitor can run 3 scans a day, and each site can be scanned once a day. A result is kept for 24 hours.
site_scan_know_robots: Rampsmith follows the site's robots.txt. If a site shows a bot check, Rampsmith stops; it never solves or bypasses one.
site_scan_know_private: A result is shown only to you, is not indexed by search engines and is never published.
site_scan_challenge_label: Check that you are not a bot
site_scan_noscript: The bot check needs JavaScript. Turn it on to run a scan.
site_scan_closed_title: The free scanner is closed for now
site_scan_closed_body: The bot check that protects the scanner is not switched on yet, so scanning is closed. Please come back later.
site_scan_err_invalid: That does not look like a website address.
site_scan_err_scheme: Only http and https addresses can be scanned.
site_scan_err_credentials: Remove the user name and password from the address.
site_scan_err_port: Only the standard web ports can be scanned. Remove the port number.
site_scan_err_address: Enter a website name, not an IP address.
site_scan_err_private: Only public websites can be scanned.
site_scan_err_challenge: The bot check did not pass. Run it again, then scan.
site_scan_err_challenge_down: The bot check could not be reached. Try again in a few minutes.
site_scan_err_rate_ip: You have used today's 3 scans. Try again in about {hours} hours.
site_scan_err_rate_domain: That site was scanned in the last day and its result is no longer kept. Try again in about {hours} hours.
site_scan_err_failed: The scan could not be completed. Try again later.
site_scan_err_robots: The site's robots.txt asks scanners to stay away, so Rampsmith did not scan it.
site_scan_err_bot_challenge: The site shows a bot check. Rampsmith does not solve or bypass those, so it stopped.
site_scan_err_unreachable: The site could not be reached.
site_scan_err_busy: The scanner is busy right now. Try again in a minute; this attempt did not count against your daily scans.
site_scan_running_body: This site is taking longer than usual. The scan is still running and keeps running if you leave this page. Check again in a moment.
site_scan_not_connected_title: The scanner is not connected yet
site_scan_not_connected_body: This page is ready, but the scanning service is not connected to it yet, so nothing was scanned and this attempt did not count against your daily scans.
site_scan_result_cached: This is the result from the last 24 hours.
site_scan_result_fixture: Test data. This is a fixed sample for testing the page, not a real scan.
site_scan_result_passes: Passes {passed} of {total} automated WCAG 2.2 AA checks
site_scan_result_none: No failures were found by the automated checks on these pages. That does not mean the site has no barriers.
site_scan_result_partial: This result is automated and partial. It cannot see what needs a person, such as whether alt text says what matters or how a flow works with a screen reader.
site_legal_draft: Draft — attorney review required. Not published.
site_legal_draft_body: This text is a working draft. It has not been reviewed by an attorney, may contain placeholders in square brackets, and is not yet in force.
site_statement_draft: Draft — placeholders in square brackets are completed before publication.
site_statement_draft_body: The statement describes what Rampsmith aims for and how it is tested. It is not a claim about the result.
site_sub_lede: The companies that process data for Rampsmith. We change this list only with 30 days' notice to customers.
site_sub_cloudflare_data: Evidence files; visitor IP address for Turnstile
site_sub_anthropic_data: None: images and product text only
site_sub_github_role: Pull requests, when the customer connects it
site_sub_stripe_role: Billing for customers who do not use Shopify
site_sub_draft: This list follows the data governance plan and is confirmed when the privacy policy is published.
site_email_unsub_lede: Nothing changes until you press a button. You can turn this email back on from this page at any time.
site_email_prefs_lede: Choose which emails from Rampsmith reach this address. Messages you need to act on for your account or your data are always sent.
site_email_cat_notification_detail: Scan results, fixes that wait for your approval, and weekly summaries for your store.
site_email_cat_marketing_detail: Occasional news about Rampsmith. We do not send this yet.
site_email_state_on: On: this address receives these emails.
site_email_state_off: Off: this address does not receive these emails.
site_email_now_off: Done. {category} are off for this address.
site_email_now_on: Done. {category} are on for this address.
site_email_note: Emails about your account, such as a copy of your data when you uninstall, are sent regardless, because you need them.
site_email_expired_body: Links in our emails work for 180 days. Open a newer email from Rampsmith and use the link in it, or change the setting in the Rampsmith app under Settings.
site_email_invalid_body: The address may have been cut short when it was copied. Open the email again and use the link in it, or change the setting in the Rampsmith app under Settings.
site_email_unavailable_title: We could not reach the service
site_email_unavailable_body: Nothing was changed. Try again in a minute.
app_settings_email_notifications_hint: Scan results, fixes waiting for approval, and weekly summaries. Emails about your account and your data are always sent.
app_settings_email_no_address: No email address is on file for this store yet, so Rampsmith has nothing to send. Add a notification email above or wait for the next sync with Shopify.
app_settings_email_failed: The email preference could not be saved.
app_setup_body: Rampsmith adds one optional link to your storefront footer, to your accessibility statement, and a form for shoppers to report a barrier. It is off until you turn it on, and it does not change your theme's files.
app_setup_steps: In the theme editor, open App embeds and switch on Accessibility statement, then save.
